title: Mahmoud and a xor trip
statementMd:
Mahmoud and Ehab live in a country with $*n*$ cities numbered from $1$ to $*n*$ and connected by $*n* - 1$ undirected roads. It's guaranteed that you can reach any city from any other using these roads. Each city has a number $*a*_{*i*}$ attached to it.

We define the distance from city $*x*$ to city $*y*$ as the `xor` of numbers attached to the cities on the path from $*x*$ to $*y*$ **(including both $*x*$ and $*y*$)**. In other words if values attached to the cities on the path from $*x*$ to $*y*$ form an array $*p*$ of length $*l*$ then the distance between them is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9344d9e36d9d0ec430632599b3053395bd4497b2.png), where ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b7092c0f7ce6535f2574569c98f7b3c2fe2c5f.png) is bitwise `xor` operation.

Mahmoud and Ehab want to choose two cities and make a journey from one to another. The index of the start city is always less than or equal to the index of the finish city (they may start and finish in the same city and in this case the distance equals the number attached to that city). They can't determine the two cities so they try every city as a start and every city with greater index as a finish. They want to know the total distance between all pairs of cities.

## Input

The first line contains integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of cities in Mahmoud and Ehab's country.

Then the second line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$) which represent the numbers attached to the cities. Integer $*a*_{*i*}$ is attached to the city $*i*$.

Each of the next $*n*  -  1$ lines contains two integers $*u*$ and $*v*$ ($1  ≤  *u*,  *v*  ≤  *n*$, $*u*  ≠  *v*$), denoting that there is an undirected road between cities $*u*$ and $*v*$. It's guaranteed that you can reach any city from any other using these roads.

## Output

Output one number denoting the total distance between all pairs of cities.

## Note

A bitwise `xor` takes two bit integers of equal length and performs the logical `xor` operation on each pair of corresponding bits. The result in each position is $1$ if only the first bit is $1$ or only the second bit is $1$, but will be $0$ if both are $0$ or both are $1$. You can read more about bitwise `xor` operation here: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitwise_operation#XOR](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitwise_operation#XOR).

In the first sample the available paths are:

- city $1$ to itself with a distance of $1$,
- city $2$ to itself with a distance of $2$,
- city $3$ to itself with a distance of $3$,
- city $1$ to city $2$ with a distance of ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8f3bf9fdacb25bb19b17c017c532cd102cb4993c.png),
- city $1$ to city $3$ with a distance of ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b45e76ca68e4969fad668f1f4193d26cdc0a0014.png),
- city $2$ to city $3$ with a distance of ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3701990d023d19c5da0b315b5057d572ec11e4fd.png).

The total distance between all pairs of cities equals

1 + 2 + 3 + 3 + 0 + 1 = 10

.
statementZhMd:
Mahmoud 和 Ehab 生活在一个有 $*n*$ 座城市的国家中，这些城市编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$，并由 $*n* - 1$ 条无向道路连接。保证可以通过这些道路从任意一座城市到达任意其他城市。每座城市都附有一个数 $*a*_{*i}$。

我们将城市 $*x*$ 到城市 $*y*$ 的距离定义为从 $*x*$ 到 $*y*$ 的路径上各城市所附数字的 `xor`（**包括** $*x*$ 和 $*y*$）。换句话说，如果从 $*x*$ 到 $*y*$ 的路径上各城市的数值构成一个长度为 $*l*$ 的数组 $*p*$，那么它们之间的距离为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9344d9e36d9d0ec430632599b3053395bd4497b2.png)，其中 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b7092c0f7ce6535f2574569c98f7b3c2fe2c5f.png) 表示按位 `xor` 运算。

Mahmoud 和 Ehab 想要选择两座城市，并从其中一座前往另一座。起始城市的编号总是小于或等于终点城市的编号（他们可以从某座城市出发并在同一座城市结束，此时距离等于该城市附有的数字）。由于他们无法确定具体的两座城市，因此他们会将每座城市作为起点，并将每个编号更大的城市作为终点，尝试所有情况。他们想知道所有城市对之间的总距离。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$）——Mahmoud 和 Ehab 所在国家的城市数量。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*$}（$0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$），表示各城市附有的数字。整数 $*a*_{*i}$ 附在城市 $*i*$ 上。

接下来的 $*n*  -  1$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $*u*$ 和 $*v*$（$1  ≤  *u*$, $*v*$ ≤  *n*$，$*u*  ≠  *v*$），表示城市 $*u*$ 和城市 $*v*$ 之间有一条无向道路。保证可以通过这些道路从任意一座城市到达任意其他城市。

## 输出格式

输出一个数，表示所有城市对之间的总距离。

## 说明

按位 `xor` 接受两个长度相同的二进制整数，并对每一对对应的二进制位执行逻辑 `xor` 运算。如果某一位中只有第一个数为 $1$ 或只有第二个数为 $1$，则结果该位为 $1$；如果两个数该位都为 $0$ 或都为 $1$，则结果该位为 $0$。你可以在这里了解更多关于按位 `xor` 运算的信息：[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitwise_operation#XOR](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitwise_operation#XOR)。

在第一个样例中，所有可行的路径如下：

- 城市 $1$ 到自身，距离为 $1$；
- 城市 $2$ 到自身，距离为 $2$；
- 城市 $3$ 到自身，距离为 $3$；
- 城市 $1$ 到城市 $2$，距离为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8f3bf9fdacb25bb19b17c017c532cd102cb4993c.png)；
- 城市 $1$ 到城市 $3$，距离为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b45e76ca68e4969fad668f1f4193d26cdc0a0014.png)；
- 城市 $2$ 到城市 $3$，距离为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3701990d023d19c5da0b315b5057d572ec11e4fd.png)。

所有城市对之间的总距离为

1 + 2 + 3 + 3 + 0 + 1 = 10

。
